request.description:
Edit a meal cart item (full replace).

Path param: item_id (integer) — the cart_item_id of a meal entry from GET /user/customer/cart.

Body:
- quantity: integer, min 1 (required)
- selling_option_id: integer, min 1 — must belong to the same meal as the cart item, otherwise 400 (required)
- notes: optional string, max 100 chars — omitting it clears any existing note

Auth: Bearer JWT token. Role must be CUSTOMER. Missing/invalid token → 401; wrong role → 403.

Responses:
- 200: { "message": "Cart item updated." }
- 400: if selling_option_id doesn't belong to the item's meal
- 404: if the item doesn't exist or isn't in this customer's cart

response.name: Edit meal cart item

request.description:
Edit an offer cart item.

Path param: item_id (integer) — the cart_item_id of an offer entry.

Body:
- quantity: integer, min 1 — how many bundles of the offer (required)

Auth: Bearer JWT token. Role must be CUSTOMER. Missing/invalid token → 401; wrong role → 403.

Responses:
- 200: { "message": "Cart item updated." }
- 404: if the item doesn't exist or isn't in this customer's cart

request.description:
Edit a returned-meal cart item.

Path param: item_id (integer) — the cart_item_id of a returned-meal entry.

Body:
- quantity: integer, min 1 (required)

Auth: Bearer JWT token. Role must be CUSTOMER. Missing/invalid token → 401; wrong role → 403.

Responses:
- 200: { "message": "Cart item updated." }
- 404: if the item doesn't exist or isn't in this customer's cart
- 400: "This returned meal is no longer available." if it has expired
- 400: "Only N of this returned meal is available right now." if the requested quantity exceeds available stock
